posting.title: Academics Manager
posting.description:
What You'll Drive

  • Steer learning, student life and academic administration across the Institute
  • Coach and develop 35+ faculty and staff — huddles, one-on-ones, termly reviews
  • Convene curriculum committees to build and launch industry-relevant courses
  • Keep regulatory records and compliance checklists audit-ready, every day
  • Represent Academics to students, parents, regulators and partners

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Education or a related field
  • 7+ years in academic management, with 3+ years leading large teams
  • Working knowledge of Kenya's TVET regulatory landscape
  • A builder's instinct for systems: calendars, SOPs, performance frameworks
  • Clear, confident communication — from classrooms to the boardroom

posting.title: Accountant
posting.description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a professional Accountant to support the financial management of GVRCs ongoing projects. The successful candidate will maintain accurate records, process transactions, prepare reports, and ensure compliance with organizational and donor requirements. Strong accounting and reporting skills are essential. NGO or donor-funded project experience will be an added advantage. This position is currently in Nairobi, Kenya.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field with Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant accounting experience, including hands-on support for project-based or donor-funded activities.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus, Team Work, Managing performance, Results Oriented, Reliability with demonstrated interpersonal skills and a high degree of professionalism and ethics

posting.title: Accountant
posting.description:
Key Responsibilities

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.

• Prepare and maintain accounting reports and supporting documentation.

• Monitor income, expenses, and financial transactions.

• Assist with reconciliations and routine accounting processes.

• Support timely preparation of financial information for management.

• Ensure accounting records are properly organized and maintained.


Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of relevant accounting work experience.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Good organizational and analytical skills.

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.


Walk-In Interviews

Days Time Venue

Saturday & Sunday

11:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Choma Shack, The Beacon Mall, Upperhill Address 3rd Ngong Avenue


Qualified candidates are invited to attend the walk-in interviews during the scheduled dates and time.
